notes.title: 2024-06-27 Version Update Note V1.3
notes.content:
1、Added ICONS for equipment and skills
2、5 Floor after the victory, added a record point, the player can go back to the 5 floor at any time
3、Remove the "sell" frame in the shop
4、6 Floor after the victory, increase the Health and Status of the training
5、6 Floor after the victory, Potions are allowed to be used
6、Reconstructed the UI of the log interface and added game tips and enemy tabs
7、Open the seventh floor of the Fantasy Tower
8、Modified button styles for skills and equipments
9、Fixed many bugs

notes.title: 2024-06-04 Patch Update V1.2
notes.content:
Important: Because of the added achievement system, the existing archive will not be used, and a new archive will need to be opened
Update content
1. The tower opens the sixth floor
2. Reconstructed the character property panel
3, unified the return button of each panel
4, increased the animation effect of the enemy in the battle scene
5. After 5 levels of Magic Tower, two skills are added
6. Increased the movement speed of characters and enemies in full screen
7. Added achievement system in the game
8. Modified a lot of bugs
